title: Model adoption snapshot + promptset hotlist (voice & search)
content:
Purpose

This snapshot is a short, actionable digest for the current model onboarding wave (v2.3 candidates) focusing on voice assistants and internal search verticals. Goal is to highlight the highest-impact promptsets that are currently causing regressions, provide a concise triage rubric, and list immediate action items with clear owners and short deadlines. This doc is intended for the onboarding squad + SRE/serving-runtime liaisons.

High level summary (past 14 days)

- Number of model candidates evaluated: 7 (3 passed baseline, 4 flagged for triage)
- Signal shift observed: increase in hallucination rate on named-entity-heavy prompts for voice (up ~3.8 percentage points vs. previous baseline).
- Stability: token-level latency regression observed for two quantized candidate builds when sequence length > 1024 (p95 latency up ~17%).
- Coverage gaps: search vertical promptsets show lower rerank precision on query reformulation sets derived from long-tail queries (20% of promptset examples underperform).

Top promptset failures (ranked by user impact)

1) voice-ner-sensitive-hotlist (severity: high)
- Failure mode: hallucination / entity-fusion on time/place/organization triples. Candidate outputs frequently swap organization names when the prompt contains constrained temporal phrases.
- Example failing input (anonymized): "Today at 3pm, call with Acme Corp in Conference Room A — what am I scheduled for?"
- Bad model output: substitutes a different organization in the response.
- Signal: 1.2k eval runs, failure rate 18% (baseline 14%), average confidence score high (false-confidence pattern).
- Likely root causes: beam search differences when quantized kernels truncate KV cache precision; also possible prompt-context window handling regression.
- Immediate mitigation: pin previous non-quantized variant for voice route (policy: rollback to v2.2-voice-fallback) and add prompt-level guard (explicit entity verification step in post-processing).

2) search-longtail-reformulations (severity: medium-high)
- Failure mode: reranker score collapse for multi-hop reformulation examples; top-1 precision drop from 62% to 49% on this promptset.
- Notes: failures concentrated on queries with >3 tokens of disambiguating context (e.g., geographic qualifiers).
- Mitigation: temporary routing of heavy reformulation queries to the dedicated index-backed reranker (experiment flag); schedule A/B to compare relevance metrics with cached results.

3) voice-multi-turn-clarity (severity: medium)
- Failure mode: pronoun resolution drift on third-party device instructions when prior turns contain ambiguous references.
- Quick triage: compare context-window handling between candidate and baseline, examine KV cache eviction heuristic differences.

Triage rubric used this cycle

- User impact (0–5): based on production traffic weighting and severity of wrong token types (hallucination > safety > formatting).
- Reproducibility (0–3): deterministic on seed/temperature and with representative examples.
- Root-cause signal strength (0–3): traces from runtime + model logits + kernel comparison.
- Actionability (0–2): whether we can patch via routing/prompt filters/quantization profile change without requiring full model rollback.

(Score thresholds: >=8 urgent, 5–7 medium, <=4 low)

Diagnostics run so far

- Cross-kernel log diffs: produced for two quantized builds; shows top-k logits shifted on named entities.
- KV cache stress tests: reproduced p95 latency increase for sequences >1024 on A100-30GB quantized runtime.
- Prompt ablation: removed leading system token in 120 examples — hallucination rate dropped by ~2.1%.

Action items (owner — what — due)

- Liam Park — Pin voice route to v2.2 for production until entity hallucination mitigations confirmed — due 2026-03-15.
- Priya Natarajan — Add entity verification post-process hook for voice responses and produce a canary on 5% traffic — due 2026-03-16.
- Marco Alvarez — Run quantization build diff with full-precision kernel fallback on A100; produce kernel-level trace and perf delta — due 2026-03-17.
- Sofia Chen — Triage search-longtail examples and set up rerouting experiment (index-backed reranker) with evaluation dashboard — due 2026-03-18.
- Product (owner: C. Kim) — Decide on acceptable precision/latency tradeoff for voice SLA changes; polyphonic stakeholders meeting — due 2026-03-19.

Planned experiments (2-week horizon)

- Experiment A: Hybrid inference path for voice entity-heavy prompts that runs a light entity-check model post-generation (approx +5–8ms median); goal: reduce hallucination false positives by 40% without rolling back.
- Experiment B: Quantization profile delta test — test bias/precision differences across int8 variants with and without kernel fallback; target is to keep p95 latency within +10% of baseline.
- Experiment C: Prompt normalization pipeline for search reformulation queries (strip noisy qualifiers, canonicalize geo tokens) to measure rerank precision lift.

Monitoring adjustments

- Add a new alert rule: entity-hallucination-rate-voice > 10% sustained over 1h for any customer cohort — route to applied-ml on-call.
- Add per-promptset telemetry to the onboarding dashboard: track top-100 failing examples, per-example confidence deltas (candidate vs baseline), and per-kernel latency breakdown.

Notes & open questions

- Is the hallucination increase purely quantization-induced or a coupled change (prompt-engineering + kernel)? We need both kernel traces and prompt ablations to triangulate.
- How tolerant is SRE to keeping a mixed fleet with non-quantized fallbacks for high-traffic voice endpoints (cost vs SLA tradeoff)?

Appendix: short checklist for next triage meeting

- [ ] Verify reproduction of voice-ner-sensitive-hotlist failures on staging with the exact production traffic sampler.
- [ ] Confirm canary routing config for v2.2 pin and observe for 24h.
- [ ] Attach kernel trace snippets to Jira ticket GHD-9921 for engineering review.
- [ ] Publish a one-page status update to the onboarding playbook Confluence and link to this snapshot.

End of snapshot.

If anything above needs further detail before the triage meeting (2026-03-14 10:00 PT), ping me or add notes inline.

Liam
